Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Faq.subtitle: If you can't find the answer to your question, contact us at contato@migosecretosimples.com.br.
Faq.q1: How to do secret santa via WhatsApp?
Faq.a1: When creating a group, a link will be generated. Just click the share via WhatsApp button or copy the link and send it.
Faq.q2: Can the organizer see who I got?
Faq.a2: No! Only the person who accesses with the registered password can see who they got.
Faq.q3: I forgot my link password, now what?
Faq.a3: At the moment it's not possible to reset the password, the ideal is to create another draw if it's at the beginning of the game.
Faq.q4: I opened the link for the first time, but it already has a password?
Faq.a4: Someone entered your name. Ask the organizer to recreate the group or contact the participants.

dicas-presente-amigo-secreto.title: 5 Tips to nail your Secret Santa gift
dicas-presente-amigo-secreto.p1: Participating in a secret santa is always fun, but choosing the perfect gift can be a real challenge, especially when we get that coworker we barely know or a distant relative.
dicas-presente-amigo-secreto.p2: The first golden rule is: investigate social media. Often, a simple look at a person's Instagram reveals their hobbies, favorite bands, or places they like to go. If that fails, ask mutual friends discreetly.
dicas-presente-amigo-secreto.p3: Finally, useful gifts never fail. A quality thermos, good earphones, or a specialty coffee kit are items that please 99% of people. The important thing is the care when wrapping and delivering!

amigo-secreto-a-distancia.title: How to organize a remote Secret Santa
amigo-secreto-a-distancia.p1: With families spread around the world and home office becoming standard, the traditional secret santa had to adapt. But the good news is that doing it online can be just as fun as in person.
amigo-secreto-a-distancia.p2: The first step is to use an online platform like ours to do the draw without anyone having to be the 'organizer who doesn't play'. Everyone gets their match via WhatsApp, keeping the mystery.
amigo-secreto-a-distancia.p3: For the reveal, set a date for a video call on Zoom or Google Meet. Set a deadline for everyone to buy gifts online and have them delivered directly to the recipient's house. The rule is clear: you can only open the package on the day of the group call!

variacoes-divertidas-amigo-secreto.title: 3 Fun variations of Secret Santa
variacoes-divertidas-amigo-secreto.p1: Tired of the same dynamic every year? Innovating the rules of secret santa can bring new life and lots of laughs to your holiday party.
variacoes-divertidas-amigo-secreto.p2: The 'White Elephant' (or Yankee Swap) is a favorite for troublemakers. Gifts are bought generically and wrapped to hide their shape. On your turn, you can choose a wrapped gift from the table or steal an opened gift from someone who played before you!
variacoes-divertidas-amigo-secreto.p3: Another awesome variation is the 'Secret Enemy' (or Gag Gift Exchange), focused on funny, ironic gifts or knick-knacks you have at home and want to pass on. The goal here isn't material value, but the creativity of the joke.
